verdict.rationale: The app signs in through a browser device-code flow at omnirush.ai/console and then serves models from "your account's catalog" (gh-9, gh-2). Provider keys are optional ("you can also add your own"), so the core of using models through a personal account without managing API keys is clearly documented. Free access rests only on the marketing tagline "State-of-the-art models, free." Missing for 10: documented free-tier scope, usage limits or quotas, and independent or hands-on confirmation that free access works without keys.
